emotional_archetype: Neo-Editorial Feminine (Archetype 3: Pastel & Soft meets Editorial)

primary_heading.description: Characterful, elegant display serif. Use italics strategically for conversational emphasis.

secondary_body.description: Clean, highly readable geometric sans for technical details and body text.

hierarchy_rules.chapter_numbers: text-7xl md:text-9xl font-light text-[#F4E1E1]/40 select-none absolute

background.description: Warm, off-white/cream base. Never pure white.

accent.description: Soft blush pink. Used for highlights, buttons, and geometric shapes.

text.description: Deep espresso/charcoal for text. No pure black.

visual_enhancers.shapes: Use inline SVGs for abstract continuous-line art and soft geometric blobs (circles, arches). Tint them with the blush accent.
visual_enhancers.borders: Delicate 1px solid borders (#E8DFDF) to separate sections, creating an editorial grid structure.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Zero drop shadows. Rely entirely on 1px borders and slight background color shifts (cream to white to blush) for depth.
visual_enhancers.textures: Include a highly subtle fixed SVG noise overlay (opacity-20) across the entire page to break digital flatness.

motion.hero_kinetic_text: Use framer-motion to mask and reveal headlines line-by-line (initial y: 100%, animate to y: 0, overflow-hidden on parent wrapper).
motion.scroll_reveal: Sections fade in and translate up (y: 40) on whileInView with viewport={{ once: true, margin: '-100px' }}.
motion.parallax: Subtle y-axis transform tied to scroll position for abstract SVG shapes in the background.
motion.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee for the clients section. Slow speed (speed={30}), pauseOnHover={true}, large gaps.

layouts.global: Generous spacing. Use py-24 md:py-32 for standard sections. Max-w-7xl containers.
layouts.header: Sticky glassmorphism nav (backdrop-blur-md bg-[#FDFBF7]/80 border-b border-[#E8DFDF]). Contains Logo (text), Links, 'Book Consult' button.

hero.structure: Min-h-[90vh] grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 items-center pt-20 relative
hero.content: Col-span-1 lg:col-span-8 z-10. Massive bold conversational H1 (e.g., 'Brand, marketing & data consulting for the fashion forward.'). Primary CTA (Blush pill button) + Secondary CTA (Text link with arrow).
hero.visuals: Col-span-1 lg:col-span-4 relative. Floating abstract SVG line-art and soft blush blurred circles.

about.structure: py-32 relative border-t border-[#E8DFDF] grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-16
about.content: Large chapter number '01' absolute top-10 left-0. Lg:col-start-3 lg:col-span-8. First-person conversational copy, large text-2xl font-serif leading-relaxed.

services.marketing_group: Editorial list style. Flex rows with bottom border, group hover reveals blush background and arrow.
services.data_group: Distinct from marketing. Architectural/Bento cards. Soft blush background cards, crisp typography, demystifying ML terminology.

clients.in_house: Slow marquee of brand names in sleek typography (Cormorant Garamond italic).
clients.consulting: Static, highly spaced asymmetric grid of typographic logos or brand names.

contact.structure: py-32 grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-16 bg-[#FDF3F4]
contact.form: Shadcn based. Custom styled: completely flat, 1px espresso borders, transparent inputs, no outline, bottom-border-only inputs (material style) or soft rounded rectangles. Service dropdown must be cleanly styled.
contact.messaging: Warm, conversational confirmation state on submit.

components_and_tech.shadcn_customization: Strip all default shadows. Use rounded-full for buttons. Form inputs must use bg-transparent and focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#2D2424]. Dropdown must NOT have a transparent background; use solid white with 1px border.

media.images_rule: STRICTLY NO STOCK PHOTOS. Use pure CSS shapes (e.g., width, height, border-radius, background) or inline SVGs for line-art illustrations and abstract blobs.
media.icons: Use lucide-react with strokeWidth={1} to maintain a delicate, line-art aesthetic.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: NEVER use generic placeholder images or stock photography. Use abstract CSS geometric shapes (circles, lines, arches) colored in off-white and blush.
Implement smooth scrolling using Lenis at the app root level.
Maintain strict typography scaling. Do not exceed text-7xl for headers.
Avoid the generic 'AI tech' look (no dark mode, no glowing gradients, no heavy shadows).
Use data-testid on all interactive elements (buttons, form inputs, select triggers).
Inputs and Dropdowns MUST have solid backgrounds (no transparent popovers).
Do NOT apply 'transition: all' globally. Use targeted transitions.
Form must include: Name, Email, Phone, Company, Service (Dropdown), Message.
Use <form> tags and proper accessible labels.
Do NOT use HTML <select>; use Shadcn Select.
All components should exist in a unified visual language defined by 1px borders, off-white/blush colors, and elegant serif typography.
